steps.title: Open the Research Factor Lab
steps.narration: We open Trendora's Research lab, where the factor, regime, and pattern statistics live. It opens in All-history mode, which pools every snapshot the system has ever recorded.
steps.point_out: A new 'Analysis mode' toggle sits at the top with 'All history' highlighted, and the grey line beneath it confirms it is pooling every snapshot.

steps.title: Switch to As-of-date mode
steps.narration: One click flips the lab into As-of-date mode. Because the top-bar date is still on the latest day, the lab tells you this point-in-time view currently equals all of history.
steps.point_out: The 'As of date' segment is now the highlighted button, and the context line explains you can pick an earlier date in the top-bar switcher to restrict the window.

expect.text: As of the latest date — equals all history

steps.title: Return to All-history mode
steps.narration: Clicking 'All history' restores the default view and brings back the full cross-date sample, so the big-picture evidence is always one click away.
steps.point_out: The 'All history' segment is highlighted again and the context line reverts to pooling every snapshot — the larger full-history figures return.

steps.title: Travel from a setup to its names on the leaderboard
steps.narration: From the Setup & Pattern lab you can jump straight to the stocks expressing a setup. Here Trendora honestly reports that no name currently qualifies rather than inventing rows to fill the page.
steps.point_out: The view lands on the Stocks leaderboard pre-filtered to the setup, showing an honest 'no matches' message instead of any fabricated data.
